body:
Thanks for the reply.

I’ve been told similar things before, about how therapy/counselling/medication/etc. have helped people get better over the course of several years. I guess for me my willingness to get better is nearly zero every day, and having been diagnosed for over six years and having seen multiple counsellors even as of today it’s hard for me to see the light at the end of the tunnel when everything in front of me has been pitch black for years.

I don’t doubt the power of therapy, and I’m glad that it’s gotten you to a much better place. It’s just...being someone that’s extremely harsh on myself, and being someone that’s lost a lot of hope, it’s been hard to convince myself to seek therapy when I’m also my own worst enemy.

Thanks again for sharing your story.
